home.title: Farm Control System

home.paragraph: Analyze your data, plan your interventions, anticipate risks and make more accurate farming decisions with a decision-support system built for real field conditions.

home.ctaBandText: Request a demo: we walk you through Farm Control System using your own data and answer your questions.

modules.title: Our Key Modules
modules.subtitle: Seven integrated modules covering all your needs.

items.title: Plot management
items.text: Plot database, geolocation, crop history and performance indicators.

items.title: Stock & input management
items.text: Stock tracking, input movements, threshold alerts and full traceability.

items.title: Fertilization management
items.text: Fertilization plans, input tracking, soil analyses and recommendations.

items.title: Crop protection & monitoring
items.text: Pest monitoring, treatment management and intervention tracking.

items.title: Irrigation control
items.text: Irrigation planning, consumption tracking and water resource optimization.

items.title: Technical & economic performance
items.text: Analysis of costs, margins, yields and profitability indicators per plot.

items.title: Decision-support system
items.text: Smart recommendations, alerts and dashboards for optimal decisions.
